laat_vaar.voor: net so goed deel van ons erfenis
laat_vaar.na: net soveel deel van ons erfenis
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'net so goed deel' can read as 'just as good'; 'net soveel deel van' is the natural Afrikaans idiom for 'just as much part of'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'net so goed deel van' is idiomatic Afrikaans for 'equally/just as much part of' and cannot be misread here, while 'net soveel deel van' leans towards the English 'just as much part of', so the proposal is no improvement.

laat_vaar.voor: staan met hul Suid-Afrikaanse deel in KwaZulu-Natal
laat_vaar.na: staan met hul Suid-Afrikaanse dele in KwaZulu-Natal
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Two parks are the subject, so each has a part and the plural 'dele' agrees with 'hul'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The distributive singular ('hul deel', one part each) is normal Afrikaans and matches the lists' 'die Suid-Afrikaanse deel'; 'dele' adds nothing and could suggest several parts per park.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'stoppe' is an unusual plural and reads awkwardly; 'stopplekke' is the natural word for the stops on a route.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'stoppe' is a normal plural of the noun 'stop' and echoes 'stop by' in the sentence before; 'stopplekke' is a lateral move that could also drift from the route's wording in the other lessons.
